finding: Slovak fixed investment financing rose, closing gap with euro area
bullets: Fixed investment financing rose from 34.2% to 40.7% among Slovak firms (n=242), a 6.5 pp increase that brought Slovakia above the EA's 38.4% — suggesting stronger capital expenditure plans.
Inventory and working capital remained the top financing purpose for Slovak firms at 57.0% (n=242), 16.2 pp above the EA's 40.8% — indicating persistent liquidity needs.
Refinancing or paying off obligations fell from 21.5% to 17.0% among Slovak firms (n=241), narrowing the gap with the EA's 15.8%.
chart_subtitle: Slovak firms cited working capital at 57.0% in wave 39.
